candidates.angle: युक्ततमः, most united, crowns the path

angle_hi: श्रद्धावान्: श्रद्धा मार्ग को शिखर पर रखती है

en.intro: Krishna has taught the method of meditation. Now listen for the single word that crowns the entire path.
en.notice: The word to hear is shraddhavan, trustful. It is not the skill of the posture but the trust of the heart that makes the worshipper the highest of all yogis.
en.next: Krishna now explains how this trust is born, by revealing his divine knowledge to Arjuna.
en.meaning: Among all yogis, the one who worships me with trust, with the inner self absorbed in me, is considered the most fully united.

hi.intro: कृष्ण ने ध्यान की विधि सिखाई। अब वह एक शब्द सुनिए जो इस पूरे मार्ग को शिखर पर रखता है।
hi.meaning: सम्पूर्ण योगियों में भी जो श्रद्धावान् भक्त मुझमें तल्लीन हुए मनसे मेरा भजन करता है, वह मेरे मत में सबसे श्रेष्ठ योगी है।
hi.notice: सब योगियों में मुझमें तल्लीन श्रद्धालु भक्त सबसे श्रेष्ठ
hi.next: कृष्ण अब यह बता रहे हैं कि यह श्रद्धा कैसे उत्पन्न होती है, अर्जुन को अपना दिव्य ज्ञान देकर।

en.intro: Krishna has taught the method of meditation. Now listen for the single word that crowns the entire path.
en.body: Among all yogis, the one who worships me with trust, with the inner self absorbed in me, is considered the most fully united. The word to hear is shraddhavan, trustful. It is not the skill of the posture but the trust of the heart that makes the worshipper the highest of all yogis. Krishna now explains how this trust is born, by revealing his divine knowledge to Arjuna.
